text:
mara_finance: Heads up — overnight we saw a ~42% spike in GPU spend for us-west-2 between 00:00-03:00 UTC. Most of the high-cost rows are untagged and show product='GPU' and resource names like gpu-autoscale. Can infra/recon dig in? Link to cost export: https://bq.company/project/dataset/table

sam_enginfra: Looking now — can you paste the top resource ids or a CSV sample? Also did we roll any autoscaler changes last night? :eyes:

mara_finance: Top-10 I pulled so far: gpu-autoscale-prod-az1, gpu-autoscale-prod-az2, worker-pool-legacy-1, playground-burst. Uploaded CSV to drive: https://drive.company/drive/file/1a2b3c

noah_sre: I can see a canary deploy at 2026-03-22T00:41Z that increased desired count 12->36. Looks like the same job was applied in both AZs without the team label. That would duplicate allocation in billing export. Running a mapping query to confirm which instances lack 'team' tag.

sam_enginfra: Quick BigQuery to map labels -> cost (run this in billing project):
```
SELECT resource_id, labels, SUM(cost) AS cost
FROM `company_billing.gcp_export`
WHERE invoice_month = '2026-03'
  AND timestamp BETWEEN '2026-03-22T00:00:00Z' AND '2026-03-22T03:30:00Z'
  AND product = 'GPU'
GROUP BY resource_id, labels
ORDER BY cost DESC
LIMIT 50;
```

noah_sre: Ran it — two clusters in az2 are missing label `team`. Those rows account for ~60% of the spike. My plan: patch a tag-backfill to add `team` label from instance metadata, then re-run attribution for those hours so finance can backfill charges.

mara_finance: If backfill doesn't finish before invoice cutoff, can we do a manual chargeback entry for affected teams? We'll need ops lead approval for retro allocation.

olivia_ccs: @ops-lead FYI — customer-facing teams need a communication plan if we retro-allocate charges. What exposure to end customers vs internal teams?

mara_finance: Short calc: team-alpha ~+8.0k, team-platform ~+3.2k, playground ~+1.5k. I'll open an internal billing ticket with these numbers and proposed retro allocation entries pending ops sign-off.

billing-bot: [alert] anomaly_detected id=ANOM-20260322-001 group=us-west-2 metric=gpu_spend change=+42% start=2026-03-22T00:00Z end=2026-03-22T03:00Z

sam_enginfra: Remediation plan: 1) patch autoscaler rollout script to include AZ guard so it doesn't double-apply; 2) run tag-backfill now: `scripts/tag-backfill --label team --source=az2` ; 3) open PR with rollout guard and requester for ops review. ETA ~4h to complete steps 1+2.

mara_finance: Thanks — please add me to the PR and paste the tag-backfill job id here when it starts. I'll also mute automated budget alerts for the affected internal teams to avoid noisy pages while we reconcile.

noah_sre: tag-backfill started (job_id=12345). Will post results + post-backfill cost diffs when the downstream pipeline processes the re-ingested rows.

sam_enginfra: Also adding a short-term budget override: increase daily GPU alert threshold for team-alpha and team-platform by 60% for 24h so pages don't fire during reconciliation. Will revert after we confirm correct attribution.

mara_finance: Copy. I'll monitor and follow up with ops-lead for sign-off on the retro allocation ticket. Thanks all.
